import math
def analyze(path,Q,scol="0.0000"):
    phi=Q-Q//3
    bycond={}
    for line in open(path):
        if line.startswith('#') or line.startswith('Q,L'): continue
        f=line.strip().split(',')
        if len(f)<17 or f[5]=='trivial': continue
        if int(f[0])!=Q or f[4]!=scol: continue          # FILTER by Q and s
        k=int(f[6]); ratio=float(f[16])
        order=phi//math.gcd(k,phi)
        o=order; j=0
        while o%3==0: o//=3; j+=1
        cond=3**(j+1) if order>1 else 1
        bycond.setdefault(cond,[]).append((k,order,ratio))
    print(f"Q={Q} (phi={phi}), s=0:")
    for c in sorted(bycond):
        mx=max(bycond[c],key=lambda t:t[2])
        print(f"   conductor {c:>5}: max ratio={mx[2]:.4f} (k={mx[0]},order={mx[1]}, n={len(bycond[c])})")
for p,Q in [("c_suite/out_kappa/spectral_gaps.csv",9),
            ("c_suite/out_kappa/spectral_gaps.csv",27),
            ("c_suite/out_kappa/spectral_gaps.csv",81),
            ("/tmp/sync243/spectral_gaps.csv",243)]:
    analyze(p,Q)
